projectName: Are you found by AI?, by Tech Horizon Labs
projectDescription: Are you found by AI? asks AI engines the questions a business's buyers type, saves the answers and shows whether the business is named, who is named instead and what to fix. The headline measure is the named share of saved answers. It also scores AI Readiness and an off-site Footprint, offers an MCP server and links an open-source Claude Code skill suite.
keyFeatures: Free scan: 2 buyer questions on ChatGPT and Gemini, no signup
Pro: up to 25 buyer questions every week across seven engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, DeepSeek, Google AI Overviews), US$79 a month per site or US$490 a year
Named share: countable saved answers that name the business, divided by all countable saved answers
AI Readiness from five site signals, with the off-site Footprint scored separately
MCP server: 20 tools on the public demo, 23 on a customer token
Free scan API at /api/scan, no auth required
Open-source Claude Code skill suite (17 skills, npx installable)
Branded PDF audit reports via audit-report-kit
Agencies and groups with several sites: ask for a rate
Free tools: AI crawler checker, DNS-AID checker, IndexNow submitter
Dated public benchmarks for Australia, the United States and the United Kingdom; 4,400+ websites measured
Saved verbatim answers showing what each AI engine said
publicApiSurface: POST https://areyoufoundbyai.com/api/scan: run a free scan
POST https://areyoufoundbyai.com/mcp with Authorization: Bearer <token>: MCP server endpoint
claude mcp add --transport http found-by-ai https://areyoufoundbyai.com/mcp/demo
npx skills add techhorizonlabs/thl-open: install the skill suite
MCP tools: get_visibility, get_answers, get_fix_plan, get_rivals, get_context and 15 more on the demo
skills/found-by-ai SKILL.md: agent wrapper for the scan API and MCP
skills/agent-readiness-scan scan_to_csv.py: convert JSON scan to CSV
tools/audit-report-kit CLI: npm run report, generate branded PDF + JSON-LD
geo-audit skill: /geo audit <url>, parallel GEO audit
geo-llmstxt skill: validate and generate llms.txt
geo-schema skill: detect, validate and generate Schema.org JSON-LD
